findings.title: cache_key_prefix silently ignored on the v3.6.3 mise-action pin
findings.label: unsupported
findings.note: The v3.6.3 pin and prefix lines exist, but nothing cited shows that version ignores cache_key_prefix (an input mise-action has long declared); the mechanism is hypothetical.

findings.title: One-time cold mise cache on every affected job
findings.label: trivial
findings.note: A one-time cold cache after a key change is the expected, self-healing cost of re-keying the cache; it is not material release risk, and head CI passed.
